title: New course — step 1 (scope)
textExcerpt: Coursebook Pick up where you left off, or open another course. STEP 1 OF 3 What do you want to make? Cancel Pick how much course you want. You can change this before anything is created. A single lesson One lesson with one check — best when you have a task in front of you today. Choose A short course (a few sessions) A few sessions that build on each other, each with its own check. Choose A full course (weeks or months) A longer course split into units; you review the plan before any lesson is written. Choose Choose one option above to continue. Nothing is generated until you review the plan on the last step. Continue
